structure: Single PDF: Academic Standards for Personal Finance (Appendix F, Grades K-12). Page 1 title; p.2 overview text and table of six areas (17.1 Personal Finance Fundamentals, 17.2 Income, 17.3 Spending, 17.4 Saving & Investing, 17.5 Risk & Insurance, 17.6 Credit). pp.3-14: one table per page with columns C1/C2 = substrand name (C2 repeats it; strand heading rows like '1. Personal Finance Fundamentals' in C2), C4 = Kindergarten to Grade 2, C6 = Grades 3 to 5, C8 = Grades 6 to 8, C10 = Grades 9 to 12 (odd columns are empty spacers). Standard codes are 17.<area>.<band>.<letter>, e.g. 17.1.6-8.A. Long statements wrap into several rows of the same column, with the code in the first row and text in following rows. Cells say 'Intentionally blank' where a substrand has no standard for a band. Bands in this document are K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12 (not the K-3/4-6/7-9/10-12 clusters).

issues: Grade bands in this document are K-2, 3-5, 6-8 and 9-12, which differ from the state guide's K-3/4-6/7-9/10-12 row clusters; labels use the document's own bands (K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12), so the assembler must map them (3-5 straddles clusters 4-6/K-3; 6-8 straddles 4-6/7-9).
Cells reading 'Intentionally blank' are labeled backup with the band of their column.

Wrapped statements: codes (e.g. 17.1.9-12.F at u68, text u69-u74) appear in separate rows of the same column; labeled by column so they stay in the correct band. Cell contents in C1/C2 (substrand names, strand headings such as '1. Personal Finance Fundamentals') applied to all bands (grades all).
u8-u18: the overview table listing 17.1-17.6 areas is labeled backup (index of categories, not itself standards).
